display_title: I Didn't Know I'd Do This
description:
After work, Yunho returns home only to find that someone has secretly entered his apartment. Tense, he opens the door, only to see him standing there. The very man who always drew the admiration of their female coworkers. At that moment, Yunho had no idea. He didn’t know their relationship would change so drastically. When they meet again after a long time apart, the two end up sharing an unexpected night together. As Yunho wrestles with his confusing feelings for Kang-sik, he also comes to realize a hidden desire within himself that he had never known before…
